info.title: Zero-Trust Migration v2 Orchestration API
info.description:
Three read/resume routes over one workflow run. This contract is additive: it does not modify or replace /api/v1 or /api/web/v1.

Approval is intentionally absent. Simulation approval and production approval remain on the separate identity-bound approval surface documented under x-approval-endpoints; they are not v2 input routes, and the input route rejects any body whose interrupt kind is an approval. See contracts/v2/README.md for the full rule.

x-approval-endpoints.description: Approval endpoints are defined by other contracts and are deliberately not declared as paths here. Listing them is documentation, not an offer to serve them from this contract.

simulationApproval.note: Identity Platform bearer token; the server derives the actor from verified claims and no actor field is accepted.

productionApproval.note: Service-token surface bound to one exact plan digest.

x-approval-endpoints.prohibition: POST /api/v2/runs/{run_id}/inputs/{interrupt_id} must return 403 with problem code APPROVAL_NOT_RESUMABLE_VIA_INPUT when the addressed interrupt's kind is simulation_approval or production_approval.

get.summary: Get the replay-friendly orchestration trace for one run
get.description: Returns node executions, checkpoints, interrupts, specialist invocations, budget ceilings, and observed budget usage, ordered by sequence.

ETag.description: Weak validator derived from the trace digest and lastSequence.

get.summary: Stream resumable v2 agent-to-agent events for one run
get.description: Server-sent events. Each data field is one A2AEvent v2 document. Last-Event-ID resumes strictly after that exact event within this run; ordering is by the event's sequence, not wall clock.

post.summary: Resume a clarification or task-input interrupt
post.description:
Resumes a paused run from the checkpoint the interrupt recorded. Only clarification and task_input interrupts are resumable here.

This route is not an approval surface. If the addressed interrupt is simulation_approval or production_approval the server returns 403 APPROVAL_NOT_RESUMABLE_VIA_INPUT and makes no state change. The request body has no actor, decision, approval, or authorization member, so a caller cannot forge a decision by shaping the body.

expectedCheckpointId must match the run's current pending checkpoint; a mismatch returns 409 and does not resume. Repeats with the same idempotencyKey return the original result.

403.description: Not resumable through this route, including every approval interrupt kind

SinceSequence.name: since_sequence
SinceSequence.description: Return only orchestration records with a strictly greater sequence.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum node executions and checkpoints to return.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Resume strictly after the most recently processed event in this run.
